description: This file defines the main application component for a Tic Tac Toe game, including game logic, player interactions, and rendering of the game board.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Handles a player's click on a square, updates the game state, and switches the turn to the next player.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to its initial conditions.

methods.name: toggleGameMode
methods.description: Switches between playing against the computer and another player, resetting the game in the process.
